Answer: C
Reason: The lateral view (Figure 2b) reveals bowel gas patterns and soft tissue densities within the posterior right hemithorax, which is characteristic of abdominal contents herniating through a diaphragmatic defect (Bochdalek hernia) rather than simple fluid or lung consolidation. This finding explains the apparent "consolidation" and effusion-like opacity seen on the frontal view (Figure 2a).
